jobs.title: Head of Finance, Al-Futtaim Health, Dubai
jobs.normalized_title: head of finance al futtaim health dubai
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID: 179448 

 Established in the 1930s as a trading business, Al-Futtaim Group today is one of the most diversified and progressive, privately held regional businesses headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Structured into five operating divisions; automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia and Africa, Al-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world's most admired and innovative brands. Al-Futtaim Group’s entrepreneurship and relentless customer focus enables the organization to continue to grow and expand; responding to the changing needs of our customers within the societies in which we operate. 

 By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration and integrity; Al-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day

 Healthcare Finance Experience is Essential 

HealthHub, part of Al-Futtaim Health, is seeking an experienced Head of Healthcare Finance to lead the financial performance, strategic planning, and commercial finance activities of our growing healthcare business.

Reporting directly to the Managing Director, this senior leadership role will partner closely with operational and clinical leaders to drive performance across our network of community-based outpatient clinics, healthcare services, diagnostic operations, and future hospital expansion initiatives.

 Applicants without significant healthcare finance experience will not be considered. 

We are specifically seeking candidates who have held senior finance leadership positions within hospitals, healthcare groups, clinic networks, medical centres, day surgery facilities, or other healthcare providers.

 About the Role 

 This is not a traditional accounting or reporting role. 

We are looking for a commercially focused healthcare finance leader who understands the operational realities of delivering healthcare services and can translate financial information into meaningful business decisions.

The successful candidate will have experience supporting multi-site healthcare operations and working directly with executives, physicians, operational leaders, and corporate stakeholders.

You will play a key role in shaping financial strategy, supporting healthcare growth initiatives, improving operational performance, and ensuring strong financial governance across the business.

 Key Responsibilities 

Healthcare Financial Performance
Drive financial performance across clinics and healthcare business units
Partner with operational leaders to improve profitability and operational efficiency
Monitor physician productivity, revenue trends, patient volumes, service line performance, and payer mix
Identify opportunities to improve financial and operational outcomes
Support business growth and healthcare service development initiatives

 Financial Planning & Strategy 

Lead budgeting, forecasting, and long-range financial planning processes
Develop financial models and strategic business cases
Support new clinic developments, healthcare expansion projects, and future hospital initiatives
Deliver meaningful financial insights and recommendations to executive leadership
Evaluate investment opportunities and strategic growth initiatives
Governance & Controls
Ensure robust financial controls, compliance, governance, and audit readiness
Oversee monthly management reporting and financial performance reviews
Manage statutory requirements and external audit relationships
Support risk management and business continuity initiatives

 Leadership 

Lead and develop a high-performing finance team
Foster a culture of accountability, partnership, and continuous improvement
Act as a trusted advisor to executive and operational leadership teams

 Essential Requirements 

Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline
Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, or CFA
Minimum 10 years of progressive finance experience
Minimum 5 years in a senior finance leadership position
Extensive Healthcare Finance Experience Within:
Hospitals
Healthcare Groups
Medical Centres
Clinic Networks
Day Surgery Centres
Multi-site Healthcare Operations
Demonstrated Experience In:
Healthcare Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
Healthcare business partnering
Healthcare operations finance
Physician productivity analysis
Revenue cycle and healthcare KPIs
Payer mix analysis
Multi-site healthcare performance management
Business case development and healthcare investments
Candidates Unlikely to Be Suitable

 This position is not intended for candidates whose experience is primarily within: 

Banking
Manufacturing
FMCG
Retail
Construction
Audit-only environments
Corporate FP&A without healthcare operations exposure

Applicants must be able to demonstrate direct experience supporting healthcare delivery businesses.

 What's on Offer 

Senior leadership role reporting directly to the Managing Director
Significant influence over financial and operational strategy
Exposure to healthcare expansion and future hospital development projects
Opportunity to work alongside experienced clinical and operational leaders
Competitive executive compensation and benefits package
Long-term career growth within one of the UAE's most respected healthcare organizations

 About Al-Futtaim Healthcare 

 We Hear Your Ambition. 

For over 90 years, the Al-Futtaim Group has been bringing the world’s leading brands of lifestyle watches, cars, home furnishings and fashion to the UAE. The Group has now introduced a whole new way of holistic healthcare through HealthHub Clinics by Al-Futtaim, its multi-speciality chain of more than 20 clinics in Dubai with over 25 specialties offering the right combination of advanced diagnostics, proven medical expertise and specialised services . 

What gives our clinics an edge is that as a part of the Al-Futtaim Group, you can expect world-class quality standards, with access to the best medical services and facilities within a healing environment. It’s a new way of healthcare that’s designed to meet a patient’s needs with a complete range of smart healthcare solutions. As testimony to this, only recently, we’ve earned a rare milestone of being the only primary healthcare network in the UAE to receive the Gold Seal by a reputed international body: Accreditation Canada. 

As trusted partners to health, we at HealthHub Clinics adopt evidence-based learning that enables us to listen to our patients more carefully. It helps us in treating the cause and not just the symptoms, while applying global best practices to ensure quality of care for every family member. Most of all, we adopt a patient-centric approach to healthcare that is reflected in the promise of our core belief: “ We Hear You. ”

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Finance
jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities 

 1. Revenue Assurance & Controls 

 Ensure end‑to‑end revenue integrity across all business units—order‑to‑cash, billing, invoicing, and collections.

 Design, implement, and monitor strong internal controls to prevent revenue leakage.

 Lead periodic revenue reconciliation , variance analysis, and root-cause investigations.

 Review and validate pricing, contracts, discounts, promotions, and revenue adjustments.

 Drive compliance with IFRS and organizational policies for revenue recognition.

 2. Process Excellence & Transformation 

 Lead large-scale process transformation initiatives within the Shared Services Center to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and automation.

 Implement digital tools such as RPA, workflow automation, analytics dashboards, and AI/ML-based anomaly detection .

 Redesign workflows for standardization across geographies and businesses.

 Create KPIs and dashboards to measure performance, leakage, recovery, and process stability.

 3. Leadership & Stakeholder Management 

 Manage and mentor a multi-disciplinary team responsible for billing, audits, assurance checks, and reporting.

 Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—Finance, Operations, IT, Commercial, Data Analytics.

 Influence senior stakeholders with insights and recommendations backed by strong analytics.

 Partner with internal audit and external auditors on revenue-related reviews.

 4. Continuous Improvement & Value Creation 

 Identify systemic gaps in revenue processes and execute corrective actions.

 Develop a roadmap for shared services scalability and maturity .

 Introduce best practices from global Shared Services/GBS frameworks.

 Establish governance models for periodic business reviews and improvement cycles.

 5. Reporting & Analytics 

 Deliver accurate and timely revenue assurance MIS, dashboards, KPIs, and performance scorecards.

 Analyze trends, identify anomalies, and highlight risks/opportunities.

 Prepare executive-level presentations for senior leadership and CFO reviews.

 Chartered Accountant with 8-10 years of experience
 7–12 years of experience in Finance Shared Services , Revenue Assurance , or Order-to-Cash , with at least 3–5 years in a managerial role.
 Proven track record leading transformational or digitalization projects .
 Strong understanding of ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, MS Dynamics) and automation tools (Power BI, Power Automate, RPA).
 Solid grasp of internal controls, contract management, and financial governance.

jobs.title: Vice President – Asset Management (Commercial)
jobs.description:
JOB PURPOSE
Lead the strategic management of Aldar's assigned commercial assets to maximize portfolio value, optimize financial performance, and enhance customer experience. Drive asset performance through leasing strategy, capital investment, service provider governance, sustainability initiatives, and cross-functional collaboration while supporting Aldar's long-term investment objectives.
The role is for the UAE national
 
ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Strategic Asset & Portfolio Management
Develop and implement asset strategies to maximize long-term value and portfolio performance.
Drive portfolio optimization through asset repositioning, enhancement, and capital recycling initiatives.
Monitor market trends and asset performance to support strategic decision-making.
2. Financial Performance & Capital Management
Manage portfolio financial performance, including NOI, occupancy, yield, valuation, and total return.
Identify value creation opportunities and oversee annual business planning, budgeting, and financial reporting.
Support investment decisions through financial analysis and performance insights.
3. Leasing, Commercialisation & Tenant Experience
Lead leasing strategies to maximize occupancy, rental growth, and tenant retention.
Identify commercialisation opportunities and oversee tenant engagement initiatives to improve customer satisfaction and NPS.
Review key leasing transactions and ensure alignment with portfolio objectives.
4. Asset Enhancement & Development Coordination
Lead asset enhancement programmes and CAPEX initiatives to improve asset performance and customer experience.
Coordinate with Development, Legal, Finance, and Operations to ensure successful project delivery and asset handover.
Monitor post-completion performance against approved business cases.
5. Service Provider Governance
Oversee the performance of Property and Facilities Management service providers through agreed SLAs, KPIs, and governance frameworks.
Drive continuous improvement, operational excellence, and cost optimization across the portfolio.
6. Stakeholder & Portfolio Collaboration
Partner with internal business units, including Development, Finance, Legal, Retail, Hospitality, and Education, to deliver integrated portfolio initiatives.
Build and maintain effective relationships with tenants, brokers, consultants, contractors, and external stakeholders.
 
RELATED YEARS OF EXPERIENCE
Min of 10+ years of at least 5 years of experience in real estate, property and asset management, investment banking, buy side or sell side advisory or other related field.
 
YOE IN MANAGERIAL POSITION
Min of 2+ years in a related managerial position
 
FIELD OF EXPERIENCE
Banking, real estate consultancy, management consultancy.
 
TECHNICAL AND INTERPERSONAL SKILLS
Outstanding analytical and quantitative skills; proficiency with standard software, including MS Office; advanced Excel skills is a must.
Proven track record in conducting valuation / financial models.
Able to analyze, evaluate and move quickly to support rapid decision making.
Ability to interpret and manage transaction documentation: NDAs, MoUs, LoI’s, and SPA’s
Ability to develop Board level papers and investment memoranda.
 
QUALIFICATION
Bachelor Degree in Engineering, Economics, Finance or Accounting, MBA (Finance), CFA, CA or CPA preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Finance (Factory)
jobs.description:
Who we are:

GMG is a global well-being company retailing, distributing and manufacturing a portfolio of leading international and home-grown brands across sport, everyday goods, health and beauty, properties and logistics sectors. Under the ownership and management of the Baker family for over 45 years, GMG is a valued partner of choice for the world's most successful and respected brands in the well-being sector. Working across the Middle East, North Africa, and Asia, GMG has introduced more than 120 brands across 12 countries. These include notable home-grown brands such as Sun & Sand Sports, Dropkick, Supercare Pharmacy, Farm Fresh, Klassic, and international brands like Nike, Columbia, Converse, Timberland, Vans, Mama Sita's, and McCain.

Role Summary:
The Senior Manager – Finance (Factory) is responsible for managing end-to-end finance operations at the factory level, ensuring robust financial control, accurate reporting, and operational finance support to manufacturing operations. The role is hands-on and execution-focused, acting as the key finance partner to Factory Operations while ensuring alignment with GMG’s Group finance policies, controls, and standards. The role covers core operational finance pillars, with a strong emphasis on compliance, efficiency, and cost discipline within a manufacturing environment.

Key Success Drivers including Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

1. Financial Control & Compliance

Ensure strict adherence to GMG Group finance policies, internal controls, and governance frameworks at the factory level

Maintain strong financial discipline across all manufacturing transactions, including inventory, procurement, and production costing

Lead and support internal and external audits, ensuring timely closure of audit findings and zero compliance gaps

Safeguard company assets through effective control mechanisms and regular reconciliations

2. Factory Financial Operations & Reporting

Oversee end-to-end factory finance operations, including month-end close, journal entries, and balance sheet reconciliations

Ensure timely, accurate, and insightful financial reporting aligned with Group timelines and standards

Monitor key financial metrics (cost per unit, yield, wastage, variances) and highlight risks and opportunities

Drive transparency and accuracy in inventory accounting and valuation

3. Cost Management & Efficiency

Partner with factory operations to drive cost optimization initiatives across materials, labor, and overheads

Analyze production costs, variances, and inefficiencies, providing actionable insights to improve margins

Track and control factory budgets, ensuring alignment with approved financial plans

Lead initiatives to improve productivity and reduce waste within the manufacturing process

4. Business Partnering with Factory Operations

People Management:

• Lead and develop the factory finance team.

• Allocate work, review outputs, and ensure high-quality deliverables.

• Build strong finance capability within the factory through coaching and on-the-job development.

• Promote a culture of accountability, discipline, and continuous improvement.

Functional/Technical Competencies:
Strong manufacturing finance knowledge (costing, BOM, variances, inventory)

Financial reporting & month-end close expertise

Cost control, margin analysis, and budgeting/forecasting

Internal controls, compliance, and audit management

ERP systems and advanced Excel skills

Data analysis and business partnering for decision support

Working capital and inventory management

Educational Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline.

• Master’s degree is an advantage.

Experience:
• 8–12 years of progressive experience in finance roles, with significant exposure to manufacturing or factory environments.

• Proven experience managing factory-level finance operations.

• Experience working in large, structured organizations with strong governance frameworks.

jobs.normalized_title: fp&a manager i real estate i contracting
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID: 181063 

 About Al-Futtaim
Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

 Overview Of The Role: 

 The FP&A Manager is pivotal in driving financial planning, analysis, and reporting for regional operations. Based in Dubai, the role involves contributing to building budgets and quarterly forecasts, enabling performance insights, and supporting senior leadership in data-driven decision making. The FP&A Manager will work closely with various departments to ensure financial strategies align with organizational goals. Success in this role demands strong analytical skills, effective stakeholder communication, and a proactive approach to problem-solving in financial processes.
 
 What You Will Do: 

 Monthly MIS 
 Extract financial reports from various sources to create meaningful monthly Flash Performance Reports for SBU/Sub-SBU level stakeholders.
 Assist in preparing monthly/quarterly Financial & Business Review packs for senior leadership within the Contracting division and Group Finance.
 Gather insights on collection and payments from respective businesses and manage monthly cash flow uploads into Anaplan.
 Handle ad-hoc reporting requests from Group Finance or internal Al Futtaim Contracting management.
 
 Budget & Forecasts 
 Engage with business and functional heads in building the annual Budget & 3-year financial plan, ensuring timely uploads into SAP Analytics Cloud.
 Support FP&A lead with collating quarterly forecasts, ensuring alignment with group-guidelines, and submission into SAP Analytics Cloud.
 Inform relevant stakeholders of final Budget & forecast P&L for their SBUs, monitor progress, and highlight indicators of lagging revenue or cost-overruns.
 
 Financial Analysis 
 Conduct monthly variance analysis for each LOB, recommending adjustments where warranted.
 Analyze overheads at GL level to highlight anomalies and unbudgeted spends.
 Understand business operations and project performance to identify instances of over/under spending.
 
 Business Support 
 Participate in monthly cash forecast meetings with business and Group treasury teams, closing observations within defined timelines.
 Support HR by enabling monthly Manpower cost reports and generating relevant insights.
 Collaborate with the Finance team in meeting Group Reporting requirements.
 
 AI & Automation 
 Identify potential areas for automation to enhance efficiency and optimize costs.
 Participate in Group-led AI trainings and implement learnings in day-to-day operations.

 Required Skills To Be Successful: 

 Strong analytical abilities and a detail-oriented approach.
 Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel modeling and PowerPoint presentation skills.
 Professional communication and interpersonal skills, with stakeholder management ability.
 Time management and prioritization skills, with agility in learning and adaptability.
 
 What Qualifies You For The Role: 

 Professional qualification in Finance or Accounting (e.g., CA, ACCA, CFA).
 3-5 years of experience in a similar role, preferably in the Contracting industry.
 Experience with ERP Financial Software such as SAP and SAC is advantageous.
 Regional work experience is a plus.
 
 About Al-Futtaim Real Estate

 With a legacy of more than six decades in real estate and asset management, Al-Futtaim Real Estate – part of Al-Futtaim – creates real impact on the communities it serves through long-term investment and growth. As one of the region’s leading private developers, the company plans, creates and manages developments across the MENA region. 

 Al-Futtaim Real Estate has a diversified, multi-billion-dollar portfolio across the real estate value chain and asset types such as residential, commercial, malls and industries including hospitality, healthcare, infrastructure and education. Flagship mixed-use urban communities include Dubai Festival City and Cairo Festival City. 

 Al-Futtaim Real Estate is also responsible for Al-Futtaim Contracting, a fully integrated, end-to-end specialist division operating across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Egypt. The business has delivered industry-leading construction, engineering, technology and FM solutions for more than 50 years.

Structured into five operating divisions; automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia and Africa, Al-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world's most admired and innovative brands. Al-Futtaim Group’s entrepreneurship and relentless customer focus enables the organization to continue to grow and expand; responding to the changing needs of our customers within the societies in which we operate.

 Important: 
 Only candidates with proven FP&A experience within a healthcare environment will be considered. Applications without this experience will not be reviewed. 

 About the Role 

FP&A is the forward-looking engine of HealthHub’s finance function—responsible for planning, forecasting, and translating financial and operational data into actionable insights that drive strategic decisions and improve both patient outcomes and business performance.

HealthHub is seeking an experienced FP&A Manager to partner closely with Finance and Operations, delivering robust analysis, financial modelling, and commercial insights across a growing healthcare network.

 Why This Role Matters 

This role sits at the centre of decision-making, enabling leadership to make informed, data-driven decisions by connecting financial performance with operational drivers such as patient volumes, utilisation, and revenue cycle dynamics.

 Key Responsibilities 

 Budgeting & Forecasting: 
Lead the development of annual budgets and rolling forecasts, ensuring alignment with business strategy and operational drivers such as patient volumes and utilisation

 Performance Management: 
Track actuals vs. budget, provide clear variance analysis, and deliver actionable recommendations to senior stakeholders to improve performance

 Financial Analysis & Modelling: 
Build detailed financial models for clinic expansions, new services, and investment cases, including ROI and sensitivity analysis

 Business Partnering: 
Work closely with clinical and operational teams to translate financial data into meaningful commercial insights and support decision-making

 Strategic Decision Support: 
Prepare executive-level presentations, dashboards, and insights to support leadership discussions and business planning

 Planning Processes & Tools: 
Continuously enhance FP&A processes, governance, and reporting tools (e.g., SAP, Power BI), driving efficiency and accuracy across the function

 Mandatory Requirements (Essential) 

 Proven experience working in a healthcare environment is mandatory (clinics, hospitals, or healthcare groups) 
Minimum 5–8+ years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, or similar roles
Strong hands-on experience in budgeting, forecasting, and financial modelling
Experience partnering with operations or business teams in a multi-site environment
Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills, with exposure to BI tools (Power BI, Tableau)

 Qualifications 

Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field
Professional qualification (ACCA, CIMA, CPA, CFA) preferred

 Skills & Competencies 

 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
Ability to translate complex financial data into clear, actionable insights
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
Commercial mindset with a proactive, solution-oriented approach

 Nice to Have 

Experience in multi-site healthcare operations (clinic networks, hospital groups)
Exposure to M&A, feasibility studies, or new business case evaluation
Familiarity with healthcare KPIs such as patient volumes, utilisation, and revenue cycle metrics

 What We Offer 

Opportunity to play a key role in a growing and dynamic healthcare organisation
Exposure to senior leadership and strategic decision-making
Competitive salary and benefits aligned with Al-Futtaim Group standards

 Diversity & Inclusion 
HealthHub is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and actively support UAE National development in line with Group Emiratisation priorities.

 How to Apply 
For compliance and data security reasons, all applications must be submitted via the official careers portal.

 About Al-Futtaim Healthcare 

 We Hear Your Ambition. 

For over 90 years, the Al-Futtaim Group has been bringing the world’s leading brands of lifestyle watches, cars, home furnishings and fashion to the UAE. The Group has now introduced a whole new way of holistic healthcare through HealthHub Clinics by Al-Futtaim, its multi-speciality chain of more than 20 clinics in Dubai with over 25 specialties offering the right combination of advanced diagnostics, proven medical expertise and specialised services . 

What gives our clinics an edge is that as a part of the Al-Futtaim Group, you can expect world-class quality standards, with access to the best medical services and facilities within a healing environment. It’s a new way of healthcare that’s designed to meet a patient’s needs with a complete range of smart healthcare solutions. As testimony to this, only recently, we’ve earned a rare milestone of being the only primary healthcare network in the UAE to receive the Gold Seal by a reputed international body: Accreditation Canada. 

As trusted partners to health, we at HealthHub Clinics adopt evidence-based learning that enables us to listen to our patients more carefully. It helps us in treating the cause and not just the symptoms, while applying global best practices to ensure quality of care for every family member. Most of all, we adopt a patient-centric approach to healthcare that is reflected in the promise of our core belief: “ We Hear You. ”

jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
Job Summary 
 The Finance Manager leads the day-to-day financial management and technical finance function of ICBA under the overall direction of the Head of Corporate Services. The role ensures that financial operations comply with ICBA policies, International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS), donor requirements, and applicable UAE laws and regulations; safeguards the integrity of financial records and internal controls; and provides timely financial information, analysis, and advice to support the Center’s research programs, management decisions, and strategic objectives.
 Job Responsibilities 
 FINANCIAL STRATEGY AND LEADERSHIP 
 Lead the development and implementation of the Center’s financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and financial management processes, in alignment with institutional priorities and under the overall direction of the Head of Corporate Services.
 Provide technical financial advice, analysis, and recommendations to the Head of Corporate Services and, as required, to senior management to support institutional planning and decision-making.
 Develop, implement, and continuously improve financial policies, procedures, and systems in line with good international practice.
 Ensure financial transactions, commitments, and approvals comply with ICBA’s delegation of authority, segregation-of-duties requirements, and financial policies.
 Prepare timely financial reports, analysis, and presentation materials for the Head of Corporate Services, Management Committee, Board of Directors, and its Finance and Administration Committee, as required.
 Support institutional financial sustainability through sound financial planning, reserve management, cost recovery, and financial analysis.
 Promote innovation and continuous improvement in financial management, systems, and resource use.
 Assess and advise on the financial implications of strategic initiatives, partnerships, investments, proposals, and organizational growth opportunities.
 Support the development of institutional strategies by providing financial insights and risk assessments.
 Partner with senior management, project leaders, and business development teams to assess the financial viability, full-cost recovery, and long-term sustainability of major funding opportunities and partnerships.

 ACCOUNTING, REPORTING, AND TREASURY 
 Oversee general accounting, project accounting, and the integrity of the general ledger maintained in the ERP, including journal entries, reconciliations, and period-end closing.
 Prepare the annual financial statements in accordance with IFRS.
 Ensure timely completion of applicable statutory, tax, and regulatory filings in the UAE and other jurisdictions in which ICBA has reporting obligations, including VAT and other required returns.
 Manage banking relationships, cash flow, funds management, and foreign exchange exposure to ensure adequate liquidity.
 Review disbursements and maintain sound financial control over expenditure, ensuring records are complete, accurate, and safeguarded.
 Oversee donor and other receivables, invoicing, cash calls, and collection of funds, ensuring timely follow-up and minimizing outstanding receivables and cash-flow exposure.
 Lead the continuous improvement and digitalization of finance processes, management dashboards, and ERP-based controls to improve efficiency, accuracy, and timely decision support.

 BUDGETING, PLANNING, AND ANALYSIS 
 Manage the annual budgeting process, including guidelines, templates, consolidation, revisions, forecasts, and timely submission through the Head of Corporate Services to the Management Committee.
 Work with budget holders and project leaders to prepare realistic budgets and monitor performance against them.
 Provide management with financial analysis, forecasts, and scenario planning to guide resource allocation.
 Maintain the cost recovery model and indirect cost rates applied across the project portfolio.
 Ensure timely monthly and quarterly management accounts, budget-versus-actual analysis, forecasts, and financial dashboards, highlighting material variances, emerging risks, and recommended corrective actions.

 GRANTS AND DONOR FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT 
 Oversee the financial management of restricted and unrestricted funds in line with donor agreements and Center policy.
 Ensure compliance with the financial and reporting requirements of donors and funding partners.
 Review donor financial reports and ensure accurate and timely submission.
 Monitor grant budgets, expenditure, and cash positions across projects and advise on cost eligibility and allocation.
 Support proposal development through budget preparation, costing, and review of financial terms.
 Provide consolidated financial oversight of the project portfolio, identifying under-spending, over-spending, funding gaps, cost-recovery risks, and financial exposure, and recommend timely corrective action.
 Coordinate donor financial close-out requirements, including final reporting, reconciliations, asset and balance clearance, and financial record retention in accordance with donor and ICBA requirements.

 AUDIT, RISK AND INTERNAL CONTROL 
 Review and continuously strengthen the internal control environment and financial risk management.
 Manage external, internal, and donor or project audits with the appointed auditors and ensure timely resolution of findings.
 Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, reporting standards, and organizational policies.
 Maintain and regularly review financial risks, including liquidity, foreign exchange, donor, fraud, compliance, project, and financial sustainability risks, and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.
 Promote fraud prevention and financial integrity and ensure suspected financial irregularities are appropriately identified, documented, and escalated in accordance with ICBA policies.

 TEAM LEADERSHIP AND CAPACITY BUILDING 
 Lead, develop, and mentor the finance team and strengthen financial management capacity across the Center.
 Establish clear performance expectations, succession and capacity-development priorities for the finance team, and ensure adequate cross-training and business continuity for critical finance processes.
 Promote a culture of service, integrity, accountability, and continuous improvement within the function.
 Provide financial guidance and oversight to ICBA regional and project offices, where applicable, to ensure consistency with ICBA policies and standards.

 Qualifications and Experience 
 Essential: 
 Internationally recognized professional accounting qualifications such as CPA, CA, ACCA, CMA, with demonstrated IFRS financial reporting experience.
 Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, commerce, or a related field.
 Minimum 10 years of progressively responsible finance experience, including at least 5 years in finance management or senior supervisory role.
 Demonstrated experience with ERP-based financial management systems, financial reporting tools, and process automation.
 Experience in an international organization, research-for-development institution, NGO, or similarly complex multi-donor environment, with demonstrated responsibility for institutional and project finance.
 Proven track record in financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting within complex, multi-donor environments.
 Strong knowledge of donor compliance, restricted fund accounting, and grant management
 Demonstrated experience managing external, internal, and donor audits and ensuring timely resolution of audit findings.
 Strong experience in treasury, cash-flow management, financial analysis, cost recovery, and institutional financial planning.
 Experience managing and developing professional finance teams.
 Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.
 Desirable: 
 Knowledge of Arabic
 Experience in international agricultural research, development organizations, or donor-funded research institutions.
 Ex

jobs.normalized_title: finance manager retail & f&b shared cost centre
jobs.description:
C2i a subsidiary of Aldar Retail Management is a forward-thinking holding company redefining the future of Hospitality, Retail, and Lifestyle destinations. Through innovation, strategic partnerships, and purpose-driven initiatives, we develop vibrant communities and pioneering concepts that include co-working, retail, and fine-dining ventures.

 Job Purpose: 
 C2i is establishing a shared cost centre to centralise accounting for its Retail and F&B vertical. Hence, we are seeking a Finance Manager that will own the accounting function end to end for this vertical; day-to-day bookkeeping through statutory close. Lead the technical and process work needed to integrate the new shared cost centre into Aldar's group ERP landscape, chart of accounts, and financial governance and controls framework.
 This is a management role in substance rather than in headcount. The AP, AR and GL processing teams supporting the shared cost centre do not report directly into this position, so the Finance Manager must own outcomes, accuracy, timeliness & control through coordination, influence and credibility with teams they do not formally manage. The role requires the maturity to set direction, hold others to a standard, and resolve issues across departmental lines without positional authority to back it up.

 Key Responsibilities 

 Accounting Function Ownership 
 Own the accounting outcomes for the full cycle across the Retail & F&B shared cost centre, transaction processing, month-end and year-end close, journal entries, accruals, and general ledger maintenance, coordinating closely with the AP, AR and GL teams that execute this work, even though they do not report directly into this role.
 Set the standards, timelines and quality bar for AP, AR and cash flow processing for the vertical, and hold shared services teams accountable to them through influence rather than direct authority.
 Oversee reconciliations with retail and F&B settlement partners (e.g. aggregators, POS providers, card acquirers), working through the relevant processing teams.
 Validation statutory and management financial statements for the entities within the shared cost centre, ensuring IFRS compliance and audit readiness.
 Act as primary liaison with external auditors for the vertical, resolving queries and closing out audit findings.
 ERP Integration & Aldar Governance Alignment 
 Assist with the technical set-up and integration of the shared cost centre's accounting processes into Aldar's ERP environment. 
 Align local processes, controls and reporting templates with Aldar governance standards and group policy requirements.
 Partner with IT/ERP teams on data migration, UAT and go-live for any system integration or consolidation activity.
 Document and embed standard operating procedures for the shared cost centre so processes are consistent, controlled and auditable.
 Retail & F&B Specific Finance 
 Build and maintain segment/outlet-level profitability reporting across retail and F&B business lines.
 Oversee inventory accounting, costing and wastage tracking relevant to operations.
 Manage reconciliations with delivery and marketplace partners (e.g. food delivery aggregators) to ensure accurate and timely settlement.
 Support pricing, promotional and discounting analysis with commercial teams, including ROI evaluation of marketing spend.
 Planning, Reporting & Controls 
 Lead budgeting, forecasting and long-term planning for the shared cost centre in line with group timelines and templates.
 Deliver flash and monthly management reporting packs with variance analysis (actual vs budget/forecast) and commentary on key drivers.
 Design and maintain KPI dashboards (e.g. footfall/covers, per-capita spend, segment margin) to support leadership decision-making.
 Identify and drive cost optimisation and process improvement opportunities across the shared cost centre.

 Candidate Requirements 

 Qualifications 
 Chartered Accountant (ICAI) or equivalent professional accounting qualification.
 Bachelor's degree in commerce/finance or related field.
 Experience 
 8+ years of progressive finance experience, including FP&A, budgeting, forecasting and financial reporting.
 Direct experience in retail and/or F&B accounting costing, segment profitability, inventory control, and reconciliation with delivery/marketplace partners.
 Proven experience leading or supporting ERP migrations/integrations (e.g. moving entities onto a group ERP, chart-of-accounts alignment, intercompany consolidation).
 Experience working within a shared service or shared cost centre model, managing accounting for multiple entities or business units.
 Track record of managing statutory reporting and audit relationships across multiple legal entities, with IFRS compliance.
 Exposure to large multi-asset or multi-brand portfolios (e.g. entertainment, retail, hospitality) is an advantage.
 Systems & Technical Skills 
 Hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion and/or Oracle FCCS, or equivalent large-scale ERP platforms.
 Advanced Excel and Power BI for financial modelling, dashboarding and reporting.
 Proficient in Microsoft 365 suite.
 Seniority, Influence & Maturity 
 Demonstrated ability to drive outcomes across teams the role does not directly manage AP, AR and GL processing sit outside this position's direct line, so influence, credibility and relationship-building are core to the job, not a soft add-on.
 Comfortable setting standards and holding shared services teams to them without formal authority, escalating constructively where needed rather than deferring.
 Executive presence and gravitas appropriate to representing the shared cost centre in front of Aldar governance stakeholders and senior C2i leadership.
 Sound judgement and independent decision-making, having operated at manager level in a prior role with meaningful scope (e.g. multi-entity or multi-brand portfolio).
 Competencies 
 Strong stakeholder management across finance, commercial, operations and group/parent-company teams.
 Cross-functional collaboration and ability to operate in a matrixed, multi-entity structure.
 Process improvement and digital transformation mindset.
 Strong communicator, comfortable presenting to senior leadership.

 Responsibilities: 

 Assist in formulating and implementing the organization's financial strategy, including long-term financial planning, capital allocation, and regulatory compliance, and risk management.

jobs.description:
This is a broad, hands-on leadership role requiring someone who can operate at both a strategic and operational level. You will help build the financial infrastructure required to support a growing international payments business while maintaining strong visibility and control over cash, profitability and financial performance. Experience within payments, fintech, treasury and digital assets will be particularly valuable given the complexity of our global fund flows.

 You will have these main objectives: 

 Treasury, Liquidity & Digital Assets 
 Maintain oversight of fiat liquidity across multiple banking and payment partners, entities and currencies, including short- and medium-term cash forecasting.
 Oversee liquidity requirements across settlement, payouts and withdrawals, ensuring sufficient funding across the business.
 Manage and optimise digital asset treasury activities, including wallet balances, exchange liquidity and stablecoins across supported chains.
 Monitor FX exposure, currency holdings and liquidity risks and provide clear reporting to senior management.
 Develop effective approaches to cash forecasting, netting, rebalancing and FX management.
 Maintain strong relationships with banking, payment, liquidity and other financial partners supporting the company's fund flows.
 Ensure appropriate controls are maintained around wallets, exchanges, banking permissions and movement of funds.

 Financial Planning & Commercial Finance 
 Lead and maintain budgets, forecasts and variance analysis, working closely with Sales, Account Management and other business functions.
 Analyse revenue, costs, margins and profitability and translate financial data into actionable commercial insights.
 Oversee profitability reporting and ensure the correct commercials, fees and pricing structures are applied to both customers and providers.
 Identify and investigate material financial or commercial discrepancies and work with relevant teams to resolve them.
 Support the development and review of pricing models, business cases and commercial proposals.
 Provide financial input into new products, markets, partnerships and strategic initiatives.

 Finance Operations, Systems & Controls 
 Partner with Technology and Product teams to improve and automate reconciliation, reporting, forecasting and financial controls.
 Investigate and resolve discrepancies between provider, banking and internal systems.
 Build scalable finance processes, dashboards and reporting capabilities as transaction volumes and market coverage increase.
 Identify opportunities to use automation and AI to improve the speed, accuracy and scalability of financial reporting and forecasting.
 Support audit, regulatory and compliance requirements relating to financial operations and treasury.
 Maintain awareness of changing regulatory and industry requirements affecting payments, treasury and digital assets.

 Finance Leadership & Management Reporting 
 Act as a key deputy within the Finance function, supporting the leadership and day-to-day management of the department.
 Take ownership of key finance processes and provide support and guidance to members of the wider Finance team.
 Oversee monthly management reporting, ensuring senior management has clear visibility of financial performance, key movements, risks and opportunities.
 Oversee P&L reporting across customers, business segments, products and markets, identifying trends and areas requiring action.
 Support the month-end and year-end close processes, ensuring financial information is accurate, complete and delivered on time.
 Strengthen financial controls, processes and governance as the company continues to scale.
 Work closely with senior leadership and provide financial analysis to support key business decisions.

 Have 8+ years of progressive experience across Finance, Accounting and/or Treasury, ideally within payments, fintech, banking or another complex financial services environment.
 Have experience operating at Finance Manager, Senior Finance Manager or equivalent level, with significant ownership of financial processes and reporting.
 Have the capability to act as a deputy to senior finance leadership and confidently take ownership when required.
 Have strong experience across management reporting, budgeting, forecasting, P&L analysis and financial controls.
 Have practical treasury experience covering cash management, liquidity forecasting, multi currency operations, FX exposure and fund movements.
 Have direct exposure to digital assets, ideally including stablecoins, wallets, exchanges, custody models and on-chain/off-chain settlement.
 Understand the financial mechanics of a payments or fintech business, including settlements, provider fees, merchant/customer pricing, reconciliation and transaction-level profitability.
 Have experience managing complex relationships with banks, payment providers, liquidity providers or other financial partners.
 Are commercially minded and able to translate financial data into recommendations for senior management.
 Have experience improving and automating finance processes and reporting, including the use of modern data and AI tools.
 Have a high level of attention to detail while being able to step back and understand the wider commercial picture.
 Are comfortable working across Finance, Sales, Operations, Product and Technology teams.
 Have strong leadership and interpersonal skills and are comfortable coaching and supporting other members of the Finance team.
 Are confident communicating with executive-level management and presenting complex financial information clearly.
 Hold a degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or a related discipline. A recognised professional accounting qualification such as ACCA, ACA, CIMA, CPA or equivalent would be highly advantageous.

jobs.title: Senior CVM & Commercial Manager
jobs.description:
Senior CVM & Commercial Manager will be responsible to build and lead the Customer Value Management practice for our luxury retail loyalty program while working towards making the programme an independent viable standalone commercial entity. The role is critical in driving long term revenue growth by identifying, understanding, and maximizing the value of our members, segment by segment, down to each individual member, optimizing retention and reducing churn or attrition.
 The role is expected to establish the function from scratch, develop strong strategies and playbooks, and identify member segments by value with the data analytics & insights team, design personalized campaigns and journeys, while continuously optimising performance through data-driven insights and testing. The Sr. Manager CVM will work closely with Insights & Analytics, Marketing, CRM, and Digital teams to deliver exceptional, tailored experiences that strengthen member loyalty and lifetime value across our ecosystem.
 Practice Setup & Strategy Development 
 
• Lead the establishment of the CVM practice, including defining governance, processes, tools, and cross-functional collaboration frameworks.
• Develop and own the overall CVM strategy while aligning with broader business objectives and luxury brand values of exclusivity, personalization, and long-term relationships.
• Create and maintain a comprehensive CVM Playbook covering segmentation methodologies, strategy frameworks, campaign playbooks, customer journey blueprints, and best practices.
• Create a knowledge base of case studies that become a ready reference for the business
 
 Loyalty Currency, Commercial Modelling & CPP /VPP Management 
 
• Own and manage the Cost Per Point (CPP) and VPP (Value Per Point) models, ensuring the loyalty currency remains commercially viable and competitive.
• Conduct CPP/VPP calculations for earning redemption, partner funding, promotions, and liability management.
• Build, model, and evaluate financial scenarios for internal and external partnerships tied to the loyalty currency.
• Ensure commercial decisions balance member value, profitability, and breakage forecasting.
• Work with Partnerships unit to enable negotiations and commercial agreements with external partner brands
Customer Segmentation & Value Growth
• Identify and refine customer value segments using behavioral, transactional, demographic, and psychographic data, in conjunction with Data Analytics & Insights team.
• Partner closely with the Data Analytics & Insights team to quantify potential growth opportunities, lifetime value projections, and migration paths (including specific cross sell & upsell opportunities for each segment.
• Define tailored value-maximization strategies for each segment, focusing on retention, reactivation, upselling, cross-selling, churn management and advocacy.
KPIs, Measurement & Optimization
• Establish clear, actionable KPIs and dashboards to measure segment wise performance, campaign effectiveness, ROI, and overall program impact (e.g., share of wallet, retention rates, LTV uplift, engagement scores, churn reduction).
• Implement rigorous testing frameworks (A/B testing, control groups, multivariate experiments) and drive continuous optimization of strategies, journeys, and communications.
 
 Campaign Design & Automation 
 
• Design personalized campaigns and initiatives tailored to luxury customers’ preferences and lifestyles to deliver specific segment wise objectives.
• Define end-to-end customer journeys with predefined triggers, timing, offers, content, and channels (email, SMS, app push, in-store, etc.).
• Lead the automation of these journeys within the CRM/loyalty platform, ensuring seamless execution and scalability. Work with loyalty operations and product management to ensure necessary integrations with Loyalty Management System, Loyalty Program mobile app etc. for seamless and error free execution. 
• Collaborate with creative, digital, and merchandising teams to ensure campaigns reflect luxury brand standards and deliver exceptional customer experiences.
 
 Cross-Functional Leadership 
 
• Act as a key bridge between Loyalty, Analytics, Marketing, IT, and Store Operations teams.
• Provide strategic guidance and coaching to junior team members and cross-functional partners on CVM principles.
• Stay abreast of industry trends, competitive benchmarks, and emerging technologies in loyalty, personalization, and customer valuation.
 
 People Management Roles and Responsibilities 
 
• Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional partners in a collaborative environment
• Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders throughout the organization, both technical and non-technical
• Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills, combined with strong verbal and written communication skills
 
 Education/Certification and Continued Education 
 
• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Statistics, or related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
Years of Experience 
• 12+ years of progressive experience in CVM, CRM, Loyalty Marketing, or Customer Analytics, with at least 3–5 years in a senior role. Luxury retail, fashion, high-end hospitality, airline, banking or telecom experience strongly preferred.
• Experience communicating with fast-paced, highly cross-functional teams with multiple stakeholders
• Proven track record of building CVM practices or loyalty programs from inception
• Strong commercial acumen and demonstrated success in driving revenue growth through segmentation and personalized customer strategies
• Understanding of luxury consumer expectations
 
 Knowledge and Skills 
 
• Project management expertise and experience managing vendors and contractors
• Expert negotiation skills
• Fintech, cards and payment industry experience 
• Expertise in customer segmentation, lifetime value modeling, and journey design and automation.
• Astute analytical mindset with the ability to identify actionable strategies from convert complex data sets.
• Hands-on experience with CRM/loyalty platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Adobe Experience Cloud, Braze or similar), marketing automation tools, and customer data platforms.
• Thorough understanding and reasonable hands on experience in commercial & financial modelling
• CPP, VPP and loyalty currency expertise
• Project management and stakeholder management skills.
• Creative yet data-driven approach to campaign design with luxury category and customer awareness.
• Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership.
• Expertise in KPI setting, testing and optimization methodologies
• Creativity in experience and value design
 
 Languages 
 
• English & Preferably Arabic
 
 Behavioral skills 
• Excellent collaborative and stakeholder management skills. 
• Ability to forge long term, trusting business relationships with senior management and can advise, support and challenge to achieve successful outcomes in a fast-moving, strongly results-driven environment. 
• Capable people manager 
• Proactive, self-motivated and commercially minded 
• Innovative and problem solver, with an optimistic but pragmatic approach 
• Adaptable, hardworking, personable 
• Team player with the ability to take complex financial data and explain the insights clearly to non-financial colleagues
• Basic analysis & modelling skills

jobs.title: Associate – Asset Management (Residential/Commercial)
jobs.description:
JOB PURPOSE 

 Support residential/commercial asset performance through analysis, reporting and execution support.

 Monitor NOI, occupancy, leasing and asset performance against approved targets.

 Support asset enhancement, commercialization and value-creation initiatives.

 Leverage AI, analytics and market insights to strengthen asset-level analysis and decision support.

 ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

 Asset Performance & Analysis 

 Monitor asset performance across NOI, occupancy, rental growth and key operational KPIs.

 Prepare asset performance reports, dashboards and variance analysis to support management decisions.

 Identify performance gaps and provide analysis to support corrective and value-enhancement actions.

 Maintain accurate asset-level financial, operational and performance data.

 Leasing & Commercial Support 

 Track leasing activity, renewals, expiries, occupancy, pricing and tenant/customer trends.

 Conduct market research and benchmarking on rents, occupancy, supply, pricing and competitor performance.

 Support analysis of commercialization and ancillary revenue opportunities.

 Provide analytical inputs to leasing, pricing and retention decisions.

 Asset Enhancement & Value Creation 

 Support enhancement and repositioning initiatives, tracking delivery, CAPEX and performance against business cases.

 Assist in preparing financial and commercial analysis for enhancement and value-creation initiatives.

 Monitor realized outcomes against approved investment assumptions and targets.

 Support analysis for hold, enhance, reposition or exit recommendations.

 Operational & Partner Coordination 

 Monitor property/facility managers and external operators against agreed performance and service KPIs.

 Support coordination of operational issues, asset requirements and performance improvement actions.

 Assist with JV, governance and relevant asset documentation and reporting.

 Support compliance, ESG and sustainability data requirements across assigned assets.

 Analytics, AI & Decision Support 

 Use AI and advanced analytics to enhance asset analysis, reporting, forecasting and market intelligence.

 Develop asset-level insights and recommendations for the Director/Associate Director – Asset Management.

 Support benchmarking and trend analysis to identify risks and value-creation opportunities.

 Collaborate with Investment & Capital Planning and Portfolio Performance & Intelligence on data and reporting.

 RELATED YEARS OF EXPERIENCE 

 Min. 2+ years in real estate, property management, investment banking or a related analytical role.

 FIELD OF EXPERIENCE 

 Real estate, property management, investment analysis.

 TECHNICAL AND INTERPERSONAL SKILLS 

 Strong analytical and quantitative skills; advanced Excel.

 PowerPoint proficiency for executive presentations.

 Financial modeling fundamentals.

 Research, data compilation and benchmarking skills.

 Strong written and verbal communication.

 Ability to coordinate across multiple internal teams.

 Application of AI and analytics to asset performance, forecasting and decision support.

 QUALIFICATION 

 Bachelor's in Engineering, Finance, Economics, Real Estate or related. MBA or CFA progress advantageous.

jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
Morgan Mckinley is partnering with a global client to hire for a strategic Finance Manager to lead their finance and accounting operations. Reporting to regional leadership, you will oversee full sets of accounts, drive process improvements, manage tax compliance, and provide robust financial insights to support business growth.

 Key Responsibilities:

 Manage the end-to-end financial closing process, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in compliance with MFRS and local statutory requirements.
 Oversee general ledger, accounts payable (AP), accounts receivable (AR), cash flow management, and fixed asset registers.
 Ensure full compliance with Malaysian tax laws, including corporate tax, withholding tax, transfer pricing documentation, and Sales and Service Tax (SST) filings.
 Act as the primary point of contact for external auditors, tax agents, and local regulatory authorities.
 Evaluate current financial workflows, internal controls, and ERP systems to identify bottlenecks and implement automation or efficiency gains.
 Establish robust internal control policies to safeguard company assets and mitigate financial risks.
 Lead the annual budgeting and periodic forecasting cycles, working closely with department heads to monitor performance and control operational expenditures.
 Provide insightful variance analysis and financial reporting to management to drive strategic decision-making.
 Mentor, coach, and manage the local finance and accounting team to foster high performance and professional development

 Key Requirements:

 Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; professional qualification (ACCA, CPA, MICPA, or equivalent) is highly preferred.
 6–8 years of combined external audit (Big 4/mid-tier preferred) and commercial finance experience, including at least 3 years in a managerial role . Chemical, manufacturing, or distribution industry background is a strong plus.
 Deep knowledge of Malaysian tax regulations, MFRS, robust experience with full sets of accounting, and a strong understanding of audit and internal control frameworks.
 Strong analytical mindset, exceptional problem-solving abilities, and high attention to detail. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.

 Our client is seeking a high-calibre Finance Manager to join a leading FMCG organization in Dubai. This role will work closely with senior leadership and will combine strong financial expertise with business partnering, strategic analysis, performance management, and executive-level reporting.

 FP&A & Financial Planning
 Commercial Finance
 Business Performance Management
 Financial Modelling & Analysis
 Management Reporting
 Executive Presentations
 Data Visualization & Dashboards
 Strategic Business Analysis
 Cross-functional Stakeholder Management
 Problem Solving & Decision Support

Someone who is equally confident in building a financial model, analyzing business performance, preparing a senior-management presentation, and working across functions to drive key business priorities.

 As a leader in luxury retail in the Middle East, Al Tayer Group's retail division, Al Tayer Insignia, hosts a portfolio of some of the world’s best luxury brands in the fashion, jewellery, home and department store categories. To manage & monitor the inventory and stock holdings ensuring system stock issues are minimized. Monitor and control movement of stock, formulate policies and control procedures in order to maintain minimum discrepancies. Ensure all returns to suppliers are managed & monitored.

 Custodian of Business inventory and responsible for overall inventory management operations.
 Responsible for warehouse storage space optimization, ABC analysis, heat map analysis and implementation

 Graduate with excellent knowledge of warehousing & inventory management

 Knowledge and Skills 
 Computer Literacy and excellent MS excel skills

 Languages 
 English

 Manage the full accounting cycle, including AP, AR, GL, bank reconciliation and month-end closing.

 Budgeting & Forecasting

 Hands-on experience with ERP/accounting systems. 
 Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills.

 Able to work independently with limited supervision.

knowledge of accounting standards, tax laws and regulations.

Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities.
 
Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
 
Effective team player with the capacity to manage multiple projects concurrently.

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance.

Job Location:

 Desert Islands Resort & Spa by Anantara

Anantara Hotels & Resorts is a global luxury hotel and resort brand rooted in Thai culture, with an intrinsic sense of authentic hospitality. Inspired by the Sanskrit word meaning ‘without end’, our spirit embodies freedom, movement, and harmony. We believe every journey should leave a lasting impression — for our guests and for our people.

Founded in 2001 in Thailand, we have since expanded across the world, welcoming guests in some of the world’s most captivating locales — from pristine beaches and private islands to ancient sites and vibrant metropolises. If you are driven by a passion for generosity, warmth and heartfelt hospitality, Anantara offers a career without limits.

The Finance Manager is responsible for overseeing the financial operations of the property, ensuring accurate financial reporting, effective cost control, compliance with company policies and statutory requirements, and strong financial governance. The role supports the Director of Finance in budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and strategic decision-making while ensuring the smooth and efficient operation of the Finance Department.

 Key Responsibilities

 Oversee the day-to-day financial operations of the hotel and ensure accurate and timely accounting.
 Supervise and support the Finance team, ensuring efficient workflow and adherence to company policies and procedures.
 Prepare and review monthly financial statements, management reports, and financial analysis.
 Assist with the preparation of annual budgets, forecasts, business plans, and financial projections.
 Monitor revenues, expenses, payroll, cash flow, and operating costs to identify variances and improvement opportunities.
 Ensure effective cost control across all hotel departments, particularly Food & Beverage, Rooms, and operational departments.
 Review accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, cash management, and bank reconciliations.
 Ensure all financial transactions are properly recorded, supported, and reconciled.
 Monitor internal controls and ensure compliance with company policies, accounting standards, and applicable UAE regulations.
 Coordinate with internal and external auditors and provide the required financial documentation and information.
 Conduct regular financial reviews with department heads and provide recommendations to improve profitability and operational efficiency.
 Ensure proper management and control of inventories, including stock counts, consumption analysis, and variance investigations.
 Monitor purchasing and receiving processes to ensure proper financial controls are maintained.
 Support the Director of Finance in financial planning, business analysis, and strategic decision-making.
 Identify opportunities for cost savings and revenue enhancement while maintaining operational standards.
 Ensure timely completion of month-end and year-end closing activities.
 Maintain confidentiality and integrity of all financial information.
 Perform any other duties and responsibilities as assigned by the Director of Finance or management.

 Qualifications & Experience

 Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
 Professional accounting qualification such as ACCA, CPA, CMA, or equivalent is preferred.
 Minimum 5 years of relevant finance/accounting experience, preferably within the hospitality industry.
 Previous supervisory or managerial experience in a hotel or resort environment is highly desirable.
 Strong knowledge of financial accounting, budgeting, forecasting, and cost control.
 Good understanding of hotel financial operations and accounting systems.
 Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
 Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial/accounting systems.
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
 Ability to work under pressure and meet strict deadlines.

jobs.title: Manager Recruitment - Revenue & Commercial
jobs.description:
The Opportunity 
 Etihad Airways is continuing an ambitious period of international growth, expanding our network, commercial reach, and global workforce.
 We’re looking for an experienced Manager Recruitment to join our Talent Acquisition team and lead recruitment across a portfolio of revenue & commercial functions. This is a highly visible role partnering with senior leaders to identify, attract, and secure talent across multiple international markets.
 You’ll operate in a fast-moving, complex environment where hiring requirements can span countries, functions, and levels of seniority. While experience recruiting within aviation would be valuable, it isn’t essential. We’re particularly interested in recruiters who have developed their careers within large, international organizations and complex matrix structures , and who understand what it takes to recruit globally.
 The role is hands-on. You’ll own searches yourself, build international talent pipelines, advise leaders on the external market, and increasingly use AI-enabled sourcing and recruitment technology to identify talent that traditional sourcing approaches may not reach.
 For someone who enjoys challenging searches, international recruitment, senior stakeholder engagement, and experimenting with new ways of finding talent, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact as Etihad continues to grow.
 What you’ll do 
 Lead end-to-end recruitment across a portfolio of commercial roles, from workforce planning and search strategy through assessment, offer, and onboarding.
 Partner with senior business leaders and HR Business Partners, acting as a trusted advisor on talent availability, market dynamics, sourcing strategy, and hiring decisions.
 Develop and execute international sourcing strategies , identifying talent across multiple geographic markets and industries.
 Build proactive pipelines for critical and recurring talent requirements rather than relying solely on active applicants.
 Use AI-enabled sourcing platforms, recruitment technology, talent intelligence, and traditional sourcing channels to identify and engage high-quality passive talent.
 Recruit across a range of commercial disciplines, with experience hiring sales and commercially focused talent particularly valuable.
 Navigate a complex, matrixed organization, balancing the requirements of multiple stakeholders while maintaining pace and quality.
 Bring external market intelligence to hiring conversations, helping leaders understand talent availability, competitor activity, and alternative talent pools.
 Ensure candidates are assessed consistently and objectively using Etihad’s recruitment and assessment methodologies.
 Champion an engaging, transparent candidate experience and represent Etihad effectively in international talent markets.

What we’re looking for 
 We’re looking for an experienced recruiter who combines strong recruitment fundamentals with curiosity about how technology and AI are changing talent acquisition.
 Ideally, you’ll bring:
 7+ years of recruitment or talent acquisition experience , with significant experience gained within a large, international organization.
 Demonstrated experience operating within a complex, matrixed organizational environment , partnering with stakeholders across different functions, countries, and levels of seniority.
 Strong experience delivering international recruitment , including proactively sourcing and engaging candidates across multiple geographic markets.
 Hands-on experience using AI-enabled sourcing tools, talent intelligence platforms, or other emerging recruitment technologies to identify and engage talent.
 Proven proactive sourcing capability, including experience identifying and engaging passive candidates rather than relying primarily on applications.
 Experience recruiting commercial talent; sales recruitment experience would be particularly advantageous .
 Strong stakeholder management skills, including the credibility to advise and influence senior leaders.
 Experience managing complex or challenging searches in competitive talent markets.
 A strong understanding of contemporary talent acquisition practices, including sourcing, assessment, candidate experience, recruitment technology, and talent pipelining.
 Excellent written and spoken English.
 Experience within aviation, travel, cargo, hospitality, or another international consumer-facing organization would be advantageous, but we’re equally interested in recruiters from other complex global businesses who can demonstrate the right recruitment capability and commercial mindset.

Recruitment Process 
 The recruitment process for this position will involve the following steps:
 All applications will be reviewed by a human-member of our Recruitment Team
 Shortlisted applicants will be invited to completed an AI-lead video interview via our third-party platform. This interview will allow you to record your responses to a range of questions related to the position and will allow you to demonstrate your knowledge and experience in a way that just your CV alone would not be able to. It also ensures fairness for you and all candidates, as all of our shortlisted candidates are asked the same questions and assessed on their responses. Whilst AI is utilized as part of the process, all responses will be reviewed by a human member of our recruitment team 
 After a review of completed video interviews, shortlisted candidates will be invited to an initial technical interview with the hiring manager. 
 Finalists will be invited to a follow-up interview with additional members of the hiring team - this may involve the completion of a brief business case assignment
 All candidates will be notified as to the status of their application as soon as is possible.
 
 Etihad Airways is more than the UAE’s national airline - we’re shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, we connect people across continents and cultures, while driving our “Journey 2030” ambition to double our fleet, expand our network and grow our people for a new era of excellence. Join us and become part of a vision where the world is your workplace and extraordinary experiences take flight.
 To learn more visit www.etihad.com 
 Recruitment Fraud Alert 

Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.

jobs.description:
The Finance Manager plays a critical role in leading the month-end close process, overseeing financial reporting, and performing detailed variance analysis to ensure accuracy, transparency, and compliance with accounting standards. This position offers the opportunity to gain deep exposure to the accounting operations of a multinational organization while contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency and strengthen internal controls. The role partners cross-functionally to assess financial risks, deliver actionable insights, and support leadership in driving informed, strategic business decisions. Strong communication and organizational skills are essential to successfully manage timelines, coordinate stakeholders, and ensure high-quality deliverables.

 Who We Are

 AVI-SPL is a digital enablement solutions provider who transforms how people and technology connect to elevate experiences, create new value, and enable organizations to thrive and grow. We are the largest provider of collaboration technology solutions, which include our award-winning managed services.

Our highly certified industry experts and innovation leaders share a vision to help people work smarter and live better. We believe that success starts with a sound team and that an inclusive and diverse workplace moves us all forward.

 What You’ll Do

 The Finance Manager plays a critical role in leading the month-end close process, overseeing financial reporting, and performing detailed variance analysis to ensure accuracy, transparency, and compliance with accounting standards. This position offers the opportunity to gain deep exposure to the accounting operations of a multinational organization while contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency and strengthen internal controls. The role partners cross-functionally to assess financial risks, deliver actionable insights, and support leadership in driving informed, strategic business decisions. Strong communication and organizational skills are essential to successfully manage timelines, coordinate stakeholders, and ensure high-quality deliverables.

 Day-To-Day Responsibilities

 Lead and develop the Middle East Finance team, providing oversight, coaching, and performance management to ensure high-quality financial operations.
 Oversee monthly close activities, including review of reconciliations and detailed variance analysis, while partnering with the Tampa team to ensure timely and accurate consolidated reporting.
 Ensure full compliance with Middle East (UAE & KSA) statutory requirements, managing local audits and supporting direct and indirect tax filings; assist with corporate audit preparation and maintain robust financial documentation and controls.
 Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the finance function by implementing new procedures, strengthening internal processes, and enhancing overall operational efficiency.
 Support monthly, weekly, and ad hoc forecasting processes, providing analytical insights across departments, including financial modeling and support for large bids and RFPs.
 Perform additional tasks, responsibilities, and projects needed to support the team and organization, ensuring flexibility in adapting to evolving priorities and objectives.

 Must-Haves

 WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 Bachelors’ degree in Accounting, Finance, Business or relevant working experience in a related field required.
 5-7 years relevant experience in a corporate accounting organization.

jobs.description:
Synopsis
 The Supplier & Cost Management Specialist - Technology is responsible for driving technology spend governance, supplier performance management, commercial evaluation, and cost optimization across the Digital Technology & Innovation portfolio. Acting as a key partner to Technology, Finance, Procurement, and Business stakeholders, the role ensures cost transparency, maximizes value from technology investments, and delivers sustainable savings through effective financial control, commercial management, and strategic supplier engagement. The position requires strong financial and commercial acumen, advanced analytical capability, and proven experience managing technology vendors and complex commercial agreements.
 Accountabilities
 Drive end-to-end visibility and governance of technology expenditure across software, cloud, infrastructure, telecom, managed services, and professional services portfolios.
 Develop and maintain technology spend forecasts, financial models, dashboards, and executive reporting to support decision-making and budget management.
 Partner with Technology and Finance teams to support annual budgeting, forecasting, cost allocation models, and financial planning activities.
 Build robust business cases and commercial evaluations, including TCO, ROI, NPV, IRR, and payback analysis for technology investments and transformation programs.
 Lead commercial negotiations, contract renewals, and supplier management activities to optimize commercial value and service performance.
 Establish supplier governance frameworks and conduct regular performance reviews covering service delivery, contractual compliance, risk management, innovation opportunities, and cost optimization.
 Identify and execute technology cost optimization initiatives across software licensing, cloud services, infrastructure, managed services, and workforce expenditure.
